keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Search text: a job title or a technology.

contractTypes.title: Contract types
contractTypes.description: Contract types to include: freelance, cdi or cdd.

remoteMode.title: Remote mode
remoteMode.description: Filter on remote work: any, full remote, partial (hybrid) or none (on site).

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: City, department or region names, for example Paris or Île-de-France. Empty means all of France.

minDailyRate.title: Minimum daily rate (EUR)
minDailyRate.description: Keep only missions whose day rate (TJM) is at least this many euros. Missions without a rate are dropped when set.

publishedWithinDays.title: Published within (days)
publishedWithinDays.description: Only missions published in the last N days.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Hard cap on the number of missions returned (and billed).

includeDescriptions.title: Include descriptions
includeDescriptions.description: Add the mission description as plain text (emails and phone numbers removed).

onlyNew.title: Only new missions (monitor mode)
onlyNew.description: Return only missions not seen in previous runs with the same state key.

stateKey.title: State key
stateKey.description: Name of the monitor state, so each saved task keeps its own list of seen missions.

computeRateBenchmark.title: Compute day-rate benchmark
computeRateBenchmark.description: Add a median, 25th and 75th percentile day rate for the results (paid add-on).

slackWebhookUrl.title: Slack webhook URL
slackWebhookUrl.description: Optional Slack incoming webhook that receives one message when new missions are found.

useApifyProxy.title: Use Apify Proxy
useApifyProxy.description: Route requests through Apify datacenter proxy. Leave off unless requests get blocked.
